[[File:Cindy Thornburg.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Cindy Thornburg]]
'''Cindy Thornburg''' is a key executive of [[Decipher|Decipher, Inc.]]<ref name="wp-decipher">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Decipher,_Inc. Decipher, Inc.], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016120556/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Decipher,_Inc. Internet Archive].</ref> She is credited on Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] team (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref>

The credits page of the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] rules booklet (1995) thanks Cindy Thornburg "for spending her vacation on the phone".<ref name="2p-credits">[https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Introductory Two-Player Game Rules Booklet], Decipher / Parker Brothers (1995), credits page. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015192404/https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Internet Archive]</ref>
